game.title: Kingdoms of Amalur: Reckoning
game.blurb: Open-world action RPG set in the Faelands, from Big Huge Games and 38 Studios (RAWG also lists Electronic Arts), published by Electronic Arts and 38 Studios, released 2012-02-07. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The hidden storyline milestones, from being reborn to the end of the story, including Mel Senshir. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Faction Questlines
chapters.summary: The House of Ballads, House of Sorrows, Scholia Arcana, Travelers and Warsworn storylines.

chapters.title: Exploration and Lore
chapters.summary: Discovering locations and hidden things, every Lorestone and reading books.

chapters.title: Alchemy, Blacksmithing and Sagecraft
chapters.summary: Potions and reagents, repairing and forging equipment, gems and shards.

chapters.title: Stealth, Crime and Persuasion
chapters.summary: Backstabs, stealing, pickpocketing, jail, bribes, locks, wards, persuasion and other mischief.

chapters.title: Combat and Destinies
chapters.summary: Fateshift, Niskaru, parries, traps, ability kills, attack chains, Unique weapons and hybrid, top-tier and Jack of All Trades destinies.

chapters.title: Downloadable Content: First Set
chapters.summary: Five hidden achievements with API names starting DLC1. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Downloadable Content: Second Set
chapters.summary: Six hidden achievements with API names starting DLC2 (one is spelled DCL2). Spoiler-guarded.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4185). RAWG keeps "Kingdoms of Amalur: Re-Reckoning" (2020) separately, and the Steam store list has both the original, app 102500 ("Kingdoms of Amalur: Reckoning™"), and "Kingdoms of Amalur: Re-Reckoning" (1041720). RAWG's store link for this entry points to 102500, so the original app was used; its schema ("Kingdoms Of Amalur: Reckoning") returned 61 achievements. StrategyWiki has no page under "Kingdoms of Amalur: Reckoning" or "Kingdoms of Amalur: Re-Reckoning". amalur.fandom.com answers the API under "Kingdoms of Amalur: Reckoning" but with only 11 linked articles (races, skills and a few others); names only were looked at, nothing copied. 17 of 61 Steam achievements are hidden. quest_21 to quest_26 ("Reborn" at 88.7% down to "Destiny Dominated" at 2.3%, one naming Mel Senshir) look like main-story milestones. Eleven hidden ones have API names starting DLC1_ (5) or DLC2_/DCL2_ (6), so they get two DLC chapters. RAWG keeps two DLC entries, "The Legend of Dead Kel" (2012-03-20) and "Teeth of Naros" (2012-04-18); which set matches which is not stated in the data, so the chapter titles stay neutral (by release order, DLC1 may be The Legend of Dead Kel, a guess). "Big Spender", "Bull in a China Shop" and "Streaker" were put with stealth and crime as a loose fit.
